@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



cd %SCRIPT_DIR%
echo %cd%
@REM 编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool_web failed"
  exit 1
)
echo -------build frontend app end------------

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

function start_mxgate()
{
  ps -ef | grep mxgate | grep mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9 > /dev/null 2>&1
  mxgate stop --force > /dev/null 2>&1
  mxgate start --config $PAS_ROOT/pas/tool/mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf
}

source /etc/profile
source /usr/local/matrixdb/greenplum_path.sh

typeset -i pid_cnt
typeset -i mxgate_pid
typeset -i sys_pid

pid_cnt=$(ps -ef | grep mxgate | grep mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf | grep -v grep | wc -l)

if [ $pid_cnt -gt 1 ];then
  start_mxgate
elif [ $pid_cnt -eq 1 ];then
  mxgate status > ~/mxgate_status.tmp 2>&1
  mxgate_pid=$(cat ~/mxgate_status.tmp | grep "PID" | grep "alive" | awk '{print $2}')
  sys_pid=$(ps -ef | grep mxgate | grep mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}')
  if [ $mxgate_pid -ne $sys_pid ]; then
    start_mxgate
  fi
else
  start_mxgate
fi
